newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares extend gains on afternoon buys.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares extend gains on afternoon buys.

text.p: Istanbul shares sharply extended earlier gains on Wednesday afternoon amid buying on the prospect of a new secularist alliance to replace the ruling Islamist-led coalition government, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 which ended the morning session up 0.78 percent at 1,419, brushed a high of 1,446 in mid-afternoon trade. It stood at 1,436 at 1220 GMT, up 28 points, or 1.99 percent from Tuesday.
